seoTitle: How to Enable Atlassian Intelligence in Trello (2026)
metaDescription: Turn on or check Atlassian Intelligence in Trello: a single Workspace-level toggle, which plans include it, and why it may already be on before you look.
intro: Atlassian Intelligence in Trello isn't something each person switches on for themselves. It's a single control at the Workspace level, and only someone with admin access to that Workspace can flip it. That design makes sense for a shared tool touching every card, but it also means the setting sits a couple of clicks deeper than a personal preference would. This guide shows where that control lives, what it looks like on and off, and a detail worth knowing before you go looking: Atlassian already turned it on for many Workspaces automatically.

steps.heading: Start from your Workspace, not a single board
steps.body: Open Trello and confirm you're looking at the Workspace that needs AI checked or changed. The sidebar under Workspaces shows Boards, Members, Settings, and Billing for whichever one is selected. If your account belongs to more than one Workspace, double-check you're in the right one, since the AI setting doesn't carry over between them.

image.caption: The Boards overview with the Workspace sidebar on the left. Settings for AI live one level deeper, inside this Workspace's own settings menu.

steps.heading: Open the account menu to reach Settings
steps.body: Click your avatar in the top-right corner to open the account menu. Under your profile info you'll see a Trello section with Profile and visibility, Activity, Cards, Settings, and Labs. Settings here is where the personal-versus-workspace split starts to matter, so it's a useful checkpoint before hunting for the AI toggle specifically.

image.caption: The account menu opened from the top-right avatar, listing Profile and visibility, Activity, Cards, Settings, and Labs.

steps.heading: Go to Workspace settings specifically
steps.body: From the Settings panel, switch to the Workspace tab instead of staying on personal settings. Personal settings covers things like email notification frequency, while the AI toggle lives under the Workspace's own settings page, alongside visibility and membership restrictions. It's an easy page to land on by accident, since both are reached from the same gear icon.

steps.heading: Find the AI section and check its current state
steps.body: On Workspace settings, the AI section sits near the top with a short line describing it as a tool that helps generate, improve, and summarize content while writing on Trello. Atlassian's documentation lists this feature as available on Standard, Premium, and Enterprise Workspaces, not Premium alone, and states that AI was already switched on automatically for Standard and Premium Workspaces that hadn't opted out before July 9, 2024. If your Workspace is on the Free plan, this section won't appear at all. Next to the description is the status, deactivated or active, and the slider that controls it.

image.caption: The Workspace settings AI section, showing the feature marked deactivated with the toggle and an "Activate AI" tooltip next to it.

steps.heading: Flip the toggle and watch for the confirmation
steps.body: Click the slider to switch it. The first time anyone activates AI in this Workspace, Trello asks you to review and accept the AI Terms of Service before the feature turns on. After that, Trello confirms the change with a small toast notification in the corner of the screen, the same pattern whether you're turning the feature on or off, so read the message itself rather than assuming from which direction you clicked.

steps.heading: Test it from a card
steps.body: Once active, open any card on a board in that Workspace and look for the AI option near the description or comment box. Try it on something low-stakes first, like summarizing a card description you already wrote, so you know how it behaves before relying on it for real work. If teammates don't see it yet, have them refresh or reopen the board; the setting is Workspace-wide, but a browser tab already open won't always pick up the change instantly.

costNote: AI is included at no extra charge once a Workspace is on the Standard, Premium, or Enterprise plan. It isn't available on the Free plan at all, so there's no toggle to find until the Workspace is upgraded.

troubleshooting.problem: The AI toggle already shows active, and nobody on the team switched it on
troubleshooting.cause: Atlassian activated AI automatically on Standard and Premium Workspaces that hadn't opted out before July 9, 2024.
troubleshooting.fix: If you don't want it, use the same Workspace settings toggle to turn it off. No separate opt-out process is needed.

troubleshooting.problem: There's no AI section anywhere in Workspace settings
troubleshooting.cause: The Workspace is on the Free plan, which doesn't include AI at all, regardless of admin permissions.
troubleshooting.fix: Upgrade the Workspace to Standard, Premium, or Enterprise to get the AI section to appear.

troubleshooting.problem: The toggle exists but flipping it in one Workspace's settings doesn't change anything for the wider organization
troubleshooting.cause: Enterprise-wide AI is controlled from the Enterprise Admin Dashboard, not from an individual Workspace's own settings page.
troubleshooting.fix: Ask an Enterprise admin to manage AI from the Admin Dashboard rather than trying to set it per Workspace.

faq.question: Does everyone on my team need to enable this separately?
faq.answer: No. It's a single Workspace-level setting; once an admin turns it on, AI tools become available to everyone with access to that Workspace.

faq.question: What subscription do I need for Atlassian Intelligence in Trello?
faq.answer: Standard, Premium, or Enterprise. Atlassian's documentation lists all three as eligible; the Free plan doesn't include it.

faq.question: Is Atlassian Intelligence already on, or do I have to activate it myself?
faq.answer: It may already be on. Atlassian turned AI on automatically for Standard and Premium Workspaces that hadn't opted out before July 9, 2024; the same toggle turns it off if you don't want it.

faq.question: Where exactly is the AI toggle located?
faq.answer: In Workspace settings, not personal settings, near the top of the page in a section labeled AI.

faq.question: How do I know if I successfully turned it on?
faq.answer: Trello shows a toast notification confirming the new state right after you click the toggle. Check that message rather than assuming, since the same style of confirmation appears for both activating and deactivating.

faq.question: Why can't I see the AI toggle in my Workspace settings?
faq.answer: Either you don't have Workspace admin permissions, the Workspace is on the Free plan, or the Workspace belongs to an Enterprise where AI is controlled from the Enterprise Admin Dashboard instead.

references.label: Atlassian Support: Activate AI for your Trello Workspace or Enterprise (official)

verifiedNote: Click path and screens come from a recorded walkthrough. Re-checked against Atlassian's official Trello documentation in September 2026, which corrected two things this guide had wrong: AI is available on Standard and Enterprise Workspaces as well as Premium, and Atlassian had already turned it on by default for most eligible Standard and Premium Workspaces, so many readers land on an already-active toggle rather than an inactive one.
